items.title: Iberia discloses customer data leak after vendor security breach
items.description: Spanish flag carrier Iberia has begun notifying customers of a data security incident stemming from a compromise at one of its suppliers. The disclosure comes days after a threat actor claimed on hacker forums to have access to 77 GB of data allegedly stolen from the airline. [...]

items.title: Critical Vulnerability in Azure Bastion Let Attackers Bypass Authentication and Escalate privileges
items.description: A critical vulnerability in Azure Bastion (CVE-2025-49752) allows remote attackers to bypass authentication mechanisms and escalate privileges to administrative levels. The flaw, categorized as an authentication bypass vulnerability, poses an immediate risk to organizations that rely on Azure Bastion for secure administrative access to their cloud infrastructure.
